item.text: I’m looking for the next refactor that reduces duplication or clarifies responsibilities without bloating this small repo. I’ll inspect the current sources and then make one focused structural change if there’s still a worthwhile target.

The remaining high-value cleanup is file-level separation: the public API still embeds the DP engine as an inner type. I’m extracting that solver into its own source file so the codebase has a clearer split between facade, algorithm engine, and CLI.

The solver is now its own file, so the public API no longer mixes validation with the DP engine implementation. I’m recompiling the full set and running both the CLI and tests to confirm the extraction didn’t change behavior.

I refactored the codebase by extracting the dynamic-programming engine into [LcsSolver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/020_longest_common_subsequence/LcsSolver.java). [LongestCommonSubsequence.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/020_longest_common_subsequence/LongestCommonSubsequence.java) is now just the public API and input guards, while the solver implementation lives in its own file. That gives the repo a cleaner split between facade, algorithm engine, CLI, and tests.

Verification: `javac LongestCommonSubsequence.java LcsSolver.java LongestCommonSubsequenceCli.java LongestCommonSubsequenceTest.java` succeeded, `java LongestCommonSubsequenceTest` prints `All tests passed.`, and `java LongestCommonSubsequenceCli abc ace` prints `2`.
